before_times: the date, the pickup time, and how many hours (or one way)
the kind of trip: a wedding, a prom, a birthday, an airport ride, a night out, a funeral
how many passengers (it sets the vehicle)
the pickup town and kind of place, the stops, and the last drop-off
whether any passenger is under 21 (no alcohol on the trip) or under 18 (the prom rules, car seats)
for an airport pickup: the flight number
after_time: the day-of contact's name and mobile
the name for the chauffeur's sign at arrivals
secure_page_only: the full street addresses of the pickup, stops and drop-off
the prom passenger list: names, ages and each parent's mobile
a passenger's accessibility needs (a wheelchair, a step that's too high)
a child's age and size for a car seat
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; 21 or older when alcohol may be brought on the trip (the example company's rule); a prom is booked by a parent or guardian, who signs the prom agreement

stop.words: someone hurt or in danger right now

steps.name: Signed contract
steps.when: before the deposit (weddings, party buses, custom quotes, funerals)
steps.result: signed by both: it books; not signed in 24 hours: the time is let go

steps.name: Prom agreement
steps.who: each student's parent or guardian signs: no alcohol, no drugs, the route and the drop-off
steps.result: signed: the student rides; not signed: that student doesn't ride

steps.name: Final passenger count and itinerary
steps.result: the vehicle and the hours are confirmed; a bigger group may need a bigger vehicle (the owner decides)

steps.name: Flight number
steps.when: at booking, for an airport pickup

steps.name: Vehicle viewing
steps.when: optional, before a wedding or prom booking

prep: The chauffeur arrives 15 minutes before the pickup time
Anyone who will drink brings an ID (21 and over)
Car seats: bring the child's own, or we bring the ones you booked

staff.skills: sedan and SUV, stretch limo, party bus, airport meet and greet, weddings, proms (two years with the company, its own rule), funerals
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each chauffeur: the driver's license the vehicle needs (a commercial license with a passenger endorsement for vehicles built for 16 or more people, a federal rule); a for-hire driver permit where the state's or local rules issue one; background and driving-record checks where required; drug and alcohol testing where federal rules require it
staff.supervision: a prom party bus carries an attendant besides the chauffeur (the company's rule)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs proms, party buses, trips over 100 miles, custom itineraries and any alcohol question
staff.stand_in: a chauffeur may be swapped for another with the right license for the vehicle, and the booker is told; a wedding, prom or funeral date can't move: a stand-in or a full refund

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; 21 or older when alcohol may be brought on the trip (the example company's rule); a prom is booked by a parent or guardian, who signs the prom agreement
children_and_age.minors_texts: a prom's texts go to the parent who booked

visit.check_in: the chauffeur arrives 15 minutes early; the booker or the day-of contact gives the check-in code at the vehicle; at the airport, at the meeting point; tour guests give their own code at boarding, with an ID for 21 and over
visit.done: DONE at the last drop-off; the chauffeur checks the vehicle with the booker for left items, cleaning or damage, with photos
visit.changes_at_visit: overtime, an extra stop, tolls and parking: billed after on the saved card, line by line

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: where the state's or the local for-hire authority's rules require it: a for-hire passenger carrier permit for the business (a livery, limousine or charter-party permit), each vehicle registered and inspected for for-hire use; a business registration everywhere
license.who: the business holds the permit, the vehicles' papers and the insurance; each chauffeur holds the driver's license the vehicle needs and, where the state's or local rules issue one, a for-hire driver permit
ask: the carrier permit number, where one applies
each vehicle: type, legal seat count, plate, inspection date
license.insurance: commercial auto liability at the level the state's rules, or federal rules for interstate carriers, set by seat count; proof before going live

never_in_a_text: a prom passenger list, ages, a child's details, a passenger's health or accessibility needs and any money details never go in a text: only the secure page
